description: Before a task goes to a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or another), check the brief: what kind of task it is, which of the parts that kind needs are there (the outcome, where in the code, how to reproduce a bug, the command that proves it works, done-when, what must not change, what is out of scope, tests, when to stop and ask, what to hand back), and what is risky as written (steps that cannot be undone with no rule to stop, keys, vague goals, several jobs at once). Returns readiness out of 10, the brief rewritten with every gap marked, and a starter CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.

brief.description: The task, as it would be given to the agent.

repo.description: Optional standing facts: commands, folders, rules.

name: check_agent_brief

rewrite.description: The brief with every missing part marked to fill.

title: Check a task brief for a coding agent
